description: RegTech Compliance Protocol: KYC/AML compliance atoms with match exhaustiveness and forall quantifier verification

atoms.name: classify_risk
atoms.description: Classify customer type to risk level with exhaustive match coverage

atoms.name: get_transaction_limit
atoms.description: Determine transaction limit based on risk level

atoms.name: verify_all_transactions_compliant
atoms.description: forall quantifier: all transactions within limit
atoms.requires: n >= 0 && limit > 0 && forall(i, 0, n, arr[i] >= 0 && arr[i] <= limit)

atoms.name: approval_level
atoms.description: Guard-based match for approval level classification
